At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 1. Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary) Roche is hiring for an expanding operation in Shanghai and is seeking to expand its site leadership team, with growing Drug Product operations. We are looking for people who have significant experience in Sterile Drug Product operations, in a leadership position, who can bring investments through qualification and into steady state operations. Roche is advancing a transformative, strategic expansion of its Drug Product operations in Shanghai, establishing a new, state-of-the-art manufacturing site integral to its global supply network. To drive this critical initiative, we seek a Head of Strategy Projects for both New DP site and the existing Small molecule site As the Head of Strategy Projects , you will play a pivotal role within the Business Support organization. You are the architect of our risk management and strategic roadmap. You will bridge the gap between high-level vision and operational execution, ensuring our resources are funneled into the priority projects. You need to work closely with OE and Digital team to deliver strategy and performance by collaboration in below main areas:
• Portfolio Integration: Translates PT China Ops strategy into a prioritized roadmap of actionable projects. Collaborates with OE & Digital to ensure performance improvement initiatives are integrated into the site portfolio with the correct resource allocation.
• Solution Design & Partnership: Defines the "What" and "Why" of strategic initiatives; partners with OE & Digital to leverage their technical expertise in lean methodologies and digital tools to design the "How" (the solution).
• Performance Management: Owns the strategic KPI framework. Works with OE & Digital to close performance gaps, using digital dashboards and OE problem-solving frameworks to ensure site targets are met and sustained. 2.
